thread:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: High 5xx rate for customer VeloxRetail on Dedicated cluster ded-02 (alert: api.gateway.5xx > 5% over 5m) :rotating_light:

sam: saw it. p95 spiking, lots of 502/504 from the gateway. looks like upstreams timing out. digging into gateway logs now.

iris: i'm oncall now, taking this. @sam can you drop the quick checks you ran?

sam: checked Grafana - error rate jumped at 10:12 UTC, correlates with CPU spike on ded-02 hosts. request latency to model-proxy instances increases before 5xx.

sam: logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-14T10:12:23Z gateway error: upstream timeout id=px-93 host=ded-02 model-proxy-3 504
2026-03-14T10:12:24Z model-proxy-3 eviction: KV cache miss sprawl, mem pressure
2026-03-14T10:12:25Z kernel: OutOfMemory: process q-launch pid=4123
```

jess: VeloxRetail reports user-facing failures for checkout flow. CS got 12 complaints since 10:20. They mark as high severity.

michael: preliminary hypothesis: noisy tenant on the same GPU pool causing memory pressure on model-proxy, leading to OOMs and gateway timeouts. ded-02 is at 92% GPU memory on node gnode-7.

ops-rohan: running quick list to find top consumers:
```
kubectl top pods --all-namespaces --selector=pool=ded-02 | sort -rk3 | head -n 10
pod-a    98% mem
pod-b    95% mem
velox-heavier-tenant-xyz  99% mem
```

sam: that velox-heavier-tenant-xyz is not VeloxRetail (different tenant). looks like a tenant saturated the pool.

iris: mitigation options: 1) immediate soft-eviction of the noisy tenant 2) route VeloxRetail traffic to ded-03 (fallback pool) 3) increase autoscaler burst capacity for ded-02. I'd like to do 1+2 quickly. thoughts?

michael: agree. safe order: (A) add route override for VeloxRetail to ded-03, (B) cordon/scale-down noisy pods in ded-02, (C) monitor for regressions.

sam: adding route override now:
```
# config snippet
redwood route update --customer veloxretail --from-cluster ded-02 --to-cluster ded-03 --priority emergency
```

eng-runtime-bot: Deploy pipeline: routing-change job started by sam (ci-8723). CI tests pass. Applying change.

sam: override applied. confirm VeloxRetail traffic now showing egress to ded-03 in logs. error rate dropping to 0.8% for VeloxRetail endpoints. :thumbsup:

ops-rohan: starting soft eviction of noisy tenant pods (drain + graceful shutdown)
```
kubectl delete pod velox-heavier-tenant-xyz --grace-period=30 --namespace=tenants
```

ops-rohan: pod terminated; kernel messages show process cleanup. GPU memory freed on gnode-7.

sam: seeing 5xx rate on cluster ded-02 normalizing to baseline. overall platform 5xx now below alert threshold.

jess: communicated to VeloxRetail support: "We've routed your traffic to an alternate dedicated pool and are mitigating noisy tenant on the original cluster. You may see transient retries. Our SRE team is monitoring." Customer asked for ETA; told them ~30m for stabilization.

iris: handing off to morning oncall (michael) for post-incident stabilization and follow-up. summary for handoff:
- Incident: Elevated 5xx/504 for VeloxRetail on ded-02 caused by tenant-induced GPU/memory exhaustion on pool nodes.
- Mitigations applied: emergency route override to ded-03, soft eviction of noisy tenant pods.
- Status: stable. VeloxRetail error rate back to baseline; ded-02 healthy after eviction.
- Next actions: verify autoscaler configuration for ded-02, tighten tenant-level memory caps, consider quota/soft-limits to prevent single-tenant saturation.

michael: ack taking over. I'll run a tail check on model-proxy logs and confirm no residual errors. Also will open a ticket to temp-isolate noisy tenant and coordinate with sales for tenant billing/limits.

sam: note: we saw model-proxy OOM entries. Need to check if any core dumps/repair required. If model-proxy restarted, check model cache warmup impact on latency.

eng-runtime-bot: core-dump-scan: no persistent core dumps found, 2 transient restarts on model-proxy-3.

michael: created INC-2026-0427 in our tracker, assigned to eng-runtime (owner: sam) and infra (owner: ops-rohan).

jess: customer update sent: VeloxRetail notified; CS will follow up with a detailed timeline.

iris: incident closed for paging. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Good job team. :clap:

sam: follow-ups captured:
- enforce tenant memory caps on dedicated pools (infra) - ops-rohan
- autoscaler burst tuning and guardrails (platform) - michael
- eval model-proxy memory leak possibilities (eng-runtime) - sam
- customer RCA and timeline (CS + SRE) - jess

ops-rohan: oncall note: we should add an alert for single-tenant GPU memory above 85% for 2m to catch this earlier. filing runbook update.

michael: handover complete. last checks look clean. archiving paged incident.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged and resolved by iris at 10:34 UTC.

eng-runtime-bot: Post-incident checklist created: /tasks/INC-2026-0427/checklist.

jess: closing out customer comms channel, will attach logs and timeline in the ticket.

iris: thanks all. moving to postmortem next steps tomorrow.

sam: tldr: noisy tenant on ded-02 filled GPU memory, caused model-proxy OOMs and gateway 502/504 for VeloxRetail; traffic rerouted and tenant evicted; platform stabilized.

michael: adding labels: root_cause=tenant_memory_saturation, impact=customer_5xx, mitigation=routing_override+eviction, owners=[ops-rohan,sam,michael,jess]

ops-rohan: note for runbook: include exact kubectl/route commands used above and add escalation to sales for tenant behavior.

iris: end of thread for paging. keep this thread for postmortem updates."
